description: Remediates deferred CLAUDE-AUTH-012 risk: panels mixed authority signals. Defines the 8 distinct visual sections the frontend must separate (diagnosis, patch_preview, verifier_result, approval_request, source_mutation_status, rollback_status, evidence_status, training_eligibility_status) and an audit() function that refuses any layout that (1) merges sections (compound section names with +, /, &); (2) is missing any required section; (3) shows a success/green state for any non-output section without a 'does NOT authorize X' caption; (4) hides a blocked state or leaves blocked_text empty. source_mutation_status and rollback_status are exempted from the negative-authority caption rule because their green state IS the answer; training_eligibility_status remains in the required-caption set because the training answer is always negative in this lane.
